title: Pen and Paper Confidence: Drawing Real Life Without Looking for an Eraser
topic_prompt: Drawing everyday things from observation with an ordinary pen, no eraser and no special materials
prior_knowledge: I cannot draw at all. Stick figures only. I have never had a lesson and I am slightly embarrassed to try.
expectations: Draw recognisable everyday objects and people from life, in pen, and not mind that it is imperfect

chapters.title: Embracing the Wobble: Why Mistakes Are Just Lines
objectives: Hold a regular ballpoint pen without tensing your hand muscles
Make marks on paper on purpose without stopping to judge them
Accept messy, uneven lines as part of real drawing

chapters.title: Looking Really Closely at Your Coffee Mug
objectives: Focus purely on the physical edges of a simple object right in front of you
Ignore what you think a mug looks like and draw only what your eyes actually see
Complete a full pen outline of a mug without lifting the pen from the paper

chapters.title: Chasing Shadows with Ink: Making Flat Things Look Round
objectives: Notice where light hits an everyday object and where it casts a shadow
Use simple lines placed close together to show dark areas
Add weight and depth to a flat outline using only ink density

chapters.title: Drawing Boxy Things Like Books and Tables
objectives: Spot tilted angles on rectangular household objects
Translate receding edges onto your flat sheet of paper using pen strokes
Draw a recognisable stack of books sitting on a flat surface

chapters.title: Finding Curves in Soft Things Like Shirts and Socks
objectives: Trace the gentle folds and bends of soft fabric left on a chair
Use curving lines to suggest flexible material
Draw a piece of clothing with confidence despite messy line work

chapters.title: Capturing People Without Drawing Stick Figures
objectives: Look at a real person or a photo and see simple block shapes instead of details
Capture the general posture and slouch of a human body in pen
Draw a recognisable human silhouette within a 15-minute time limit

chapters.title: Putting It All Together: A Complete Scene from Your Room
objectives: Select a corner of your room containing multiple everyday objects
Arrange a small still-life scene on paper using overlapping pen lines
Finish a complete drawing and feel proud of its imperfect charm
